provenance.ballPolicy: Moxie-specific separate ball arc follows her right hand into the high finish, then advances toward the hoop and releases on tick21. The art never contains a ball or rim.
provenance.cleanupNotes: Smooth generated purple backdrop removed with Moxie local RGB-contrast alpha cleanup (Gaussian sigma38px; alpha fade contrast21–42). Raw source retained; fifteen source components isolated during atlas packing.

review.reviewNotes: Fifteen complete distinct Moxie human poses in 5x3 row-major layout. Consistent adult face/anatomy, pale skin, lavender eyes, very long gold-tied lavender ponytail, purple/silver uniform and shoes. Clear run-up, one-hand right-arm rise, apex/power push, release at frame10/tick21, scoring finish, descent and grounded recovery. Separate basketball is not drawn. Background-cleaned alpha reviewed.

provenance.packaging: package-dunk15.py --isolate-components; 128x96 cells; baseline94; WebP88; no generated extra frames

repack.fit: uniform scale, never upscale; max 86px high and cell width minus 10px; centered horizontally and baseline aligned with 5px bottom clearance

runtimeTrackCalibration.source: human source-cell hand estimate; formulas documented in per-clip layout provenance
runtimeTrackCalibration.notes: Aerial contact points in frames8-10 calibrated from the visible Moxie hand and checked at last carried tick20 in both facings at standard and120% native Canvas zoom. Frame10 ball resolves at the rim on tick21. Raw source ballTrack remains preserved separately.
